Title: Public Preview: Azure Migrate Supports Premium SSD v2 Disks

Body.Content: Azure Migrate now supports migration to Premium SSD v2 disks, providing users with advanced disk options that offer greater flexibility and enhanced performance. These disks are ideal for mission-critical applications that require high IOPS & throughput, low latency, scalability, reliability, and competitive pricing compared to their predecessors. During assessments in regions where Premium SSD v2 disks are available, Azure Migrate will recommend them as a target for data disks, ensuring a migration experience that is on par with other disks supported by Azure Migrate.
